name: A ceiling tube in the control room burns out
notes: PLAY-31-34 (Tom's suggestion, 14 November). Played by FS47Calm in a false alarm's slot, from week 2 (day 8), on about one night in four that asks (odds), only with the player in the control room and a tube of 2 and 3 still lit (2 over the middle of the room first, then 3 over the phone desk, which keeps its desk lamp). The night holds still, one tube sparks once (the tube beat, kind worn: one 80 ms flash, a slow fade with calm flashes) and that end of the room stays dim; a line goes on tonight's night log. The day shift puts a new one in at 08:00, and Dale says a word about it that evening (tube_wear_dale). A pair from the store puts it back sooner. The breaker does not: a burned tube is not a tripped one. No finding, no danger, no camera.

beats.text: That tube was old. The day shift can put a new one in.
